title: vulpia myuros subsp. bromoides
intro: Vulpia myuros subsp. bromoides, commonly known as Brome Veldgrass or Brome Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The plant has been reported to possess therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Vulpia myuros subsp. bromoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
